plate.title: B11 · Counterturned interior gardens
plate.description: Each actual pointed chamber supplies its own finite interior placement read and source port. Wide opposed sprays or a radial blossom occupy the interior. The detail has four dominant diagonal petals, four short axial petals, one centre and quiet veins; its uninterrupted parent rails remain legible. Alternate chamber families take different colours.
